info.name: PickleCoach API
info.description: Complete API collection for PickleCoach with test scripts

request.description: Check if the server and database are running
Register a new user account. Optional: avatar_url (valid URL, max 255 chars). Response includes user.avatar_url (null if not set).
Request password reset link via email
Reset password using token from forgot-password email
Update user (admin only - can update role and is_active)

item.name: Coaches
item.description: Coach endpoints use the coach's **user id** (users.id) to identify a coach. Set the environment variable `coach_id` to that user id for path params and body fields that reference a coach. This is not the coach_profile.id.

request.description: Get coach details by ID (public). The path parameter :id is the coach's **user id** (users.id), not the coach_profile id. Set the environment variable `coach_id` to the user id of the coach you want to look up.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": null,
  "headline": "Professional Pickleball Coach",
  "bio": "Experienced pickleball coach with 10 years of teaching",
  "hourly_rate": 50.00,
  "experience_years": 10,
  "skill_level": "advanced",
  "certifications": "USAPA Certified",
  "location": "New York, NY"
}

request.description: Create coach profile (for users with coach role). Response `user_id` is the coach's user id; the test script saves it to `coach_id` for use in GET /coaches/:id and PUT /coaches/profile/:id.

exec: // Save coach's user id (used by GET /coaches/:id)

body.raw:
{
  "headline": "Updated Headline",
  "bio": "Updated bio with more experience",
  "hourly_rate": 60.00,
  "experience_years": 12,
  "skill_level": "advanced",
  "certifications": "USAPA Certified, PPR Certified",
  "location": "Los Angeles, CA"
}

request.description: Update coach profile. The path parameter :id is the coach's **user id** (same as GET /coaches/:id). Set `coach_id` to that user id.
Create coach availability slot. Body `coach_id` is the coach's **user id** (set `coach_id` env var).
Get coach availability (public). Path parameter :id is the coach's **user id** (same as GET /coaches/:id). Set `coach_id` to that user id.

Link an existing court to the coach's available courts. Create courts with POST /api/courts first (coaches are auto-linked when they create). Body: court_id (required), optional rate_modifier, preferred, notes.
List courts associated with the authenticated coach. Use after creating courts and adding them to your coach profile.

Initiate Stripe Connect onboarding for coach payouts. When logged in as a coach, coach_id is ignored (uses your user id). When logged in as admin, set coach_id to the coach's **user id** to onboard that coach.
Get Stripe Connect account status for coach
Search courts (with lazy import from OpenStreetMap if no results)
